initial.title: [v0.92][C-SDLC v2][blocker] Support truthful initialized-phase acceptance and plan-step repair
initial.goal: Allow an existing unbound initialized or ready issue to repair STP acceptance criteria and SPP plan steps through typed, audited, atomic C-SDLC v2 operations.
initial.required_outcome: The typed card owner supports exact initialized/ready acceptance and plan-step replacement, invalidates stale design approval, preserves lifecycle identity and audit truth, and proves the behavior with focused fail-closed regression tests.
declared_scope: Design-review invalidation after acceptance or plan-step repair
authority_boundary: Only csdlc-edit apply owns semantic card mutation
Only STP replace_acceptance_criteria and SPP replace_plan_steps gain initialized/ready authorization
The existing store transaction, CAS, cross-card validator, renderer, and audit remain authoritative
Binding, execution, review, publication, merge, and terminal authority are unchanged
operator_constraints: Do not bind or mutate #205 before #213 is reviewed and merged ancestrally
Never hand-edit rendered cards or values state
Use the typed C-SDLC v2 lifecycle
Open a ready PR and stop before merge
initial.task_boundary: Change only the initialized/ready authorization and review-invalidation behavior for the two existing semantic operations, plus focused tests and issue-local lifecycle evidence.
deliverables: Initialized/ready STP acceptance-criteria repair through csdlc-edit apply
Initialized/ready SPP plan-step repair through csdlc-edit apply
Fresh design-review requirement after either repair
Focused atomicity, CAS, ownership, coverage, regeneration, audit, and reapproval regression proof
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: An existing unbound initialized or ready issue can replace STP acceptance criteria through the existing typed semantic operation without deleting or rebootstrapping its record.
AC-2: An existing unbound initialized or ready issue can replace SPP plan steps through the existing typed semantic operation without deleting or rebootstrapping its record.

AC-3: Repository, issue, initialization lineage, lifecycle phase, topology, transition history, audit prefix, and every untouched semantic field remain preserved while all six projections regenerate atomically at one new generation.
AC-4: Either repair invalidates prior design approval and doctor blocks until a fresh exact design approval is recorded; reapproval restores readiness without resetting audit truth.

AC-5: Stale generation/digest, empty or malformed acceptance criteria, invalid/duplicate plan steps, missing acceptance coverage, wrong card ownership, unsupported phase, and interrupted writes fail closed without partial mutation.
AC-6: Existing bound and implemented operation behavior remains unchanged, and no execution, review, publication, merge, terminal, or Git-topology authority is added pre-bind.
AC-7: Focused Gate 2 tests prove the exact initialized and ready sequences, preservation, regeneration, audit, doctor, reapproval, rejection, and atomicity contracts.
AC-8: Formatting, the complete Gate 2 integration target, strict all-target C-SDLC v2 Clippy, diff hygiene, and fresh independent exact-head review pass before a ready unmerged PR opens.
dependencies: Issue #213 is the tooling prerequisite for #205's final preparation repair
No #205 dependency is required to implement this owner-level tooling fix
non_goals: Generic JSON Patch, raw values editing, or Markdown mutation
Record deletion, rebootstrap, or audit reset as repair
Any weakening of dependency, bind, review, publication, merge, or closeout gates
initial.plan_summary: Prepare and review the exact two-operation contract, bind #213, implement the narrow phase authorization plus review invalidation, prove both phases and fail-closed boundaries, independently review, and publish a ready unmerged PR.

steps.action: Independently review and approve the exact initialized/ready operation, preservation, invalidation, and non-authority design, then bind #213.
Extend only authorize_card_operation for the exact STP/SPP combinations and invalidate design review after either successful initialized/ready repair.
Add focused Gate 2 sequences and rejection fixtures proving both phases, both operations, CAS, ownership, cross-card coverage, atomic regeneration, append-only audit, doctor blocking, and reapproval.
Run formatting, complete Gate 2, strict all-target Clippy, diff hygiene, and truthful typed final validation.
Obtain fresh independent exact-head subagent review, resolve every actionable finding, and publish a ready PR closing #213 without merge.

invariants: Pre-bind edits grant no execution or Git topology authority
Only the two declared card/operation combinations are widened
CAS, card ownership, cross-card coverage, rendering, audit, and transaction atomicity remain fail closed
A substantive acceptance or plan-step repair requires fresh design approval
#205 remains unchanged until #213 is reviewed and merged ancestrally
risks: Over-broad phase authorization could permit execution-like mutation before bind
Review invalidation could be omitted and leave stale approval green
Cross-card acceptance coverage could be weakened instead of preserved
A regression test could prove only one phase or one operation
stop_conditions: The repair requires a raw card/state mutation path
The exact operations cannot remain limited to initialized/ready STP/SPP ownership
Atomic regeneration or audit preservation would be weakened
An actionable independent review finding remains unresolved

validation_lanes.proof_role: The complete Gate 2 integration target proves initialized/ready acceptance and plan-step repair, fail-closed ownership/CAS/coverage/atomicity, regenerated projections, audit preservation, doctor blocking, and exact reapproval while retaining existing lifecycle behavior.
Strict all-target Clippy rejects warnings and unsafe owner-level API changes after Gate 2 passes.
Formatting check proves the touched Rust source and test remain canonical.
Diff hygiene rejects whitespace and patch defects before review and publication.

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on any phase widening beyond the exact operations, stale CAS, invalid card ownership, broken acceptance coverage, partial generation/audit/projection mutation, stale design approval, or validation/review failure.
review_prompts: Are only initialized/ready STP replace_acceptance_criteria and SPP replace_plan_steps newly authorized?
Does either successful repair invalidate design approval without changing phase or granting topology/execution authority?
Do cross-card coverage, semantic validation, CAS, atomic rendering, generation, and append-only audit remain fail closed?
Do focused tests prove both phases, both operations, all rejection boundaries, doctor blocking, and reapproval?
Did the change leave #205 and every publication/merge/terminal boundary untouched?
initial.review_scope: Issue #213 exact design, authorize_card_operation change, design-review invalidation, Gate 2 regression proof, lifecycle records, and absence of #205 or broader authority changes.
